The original data point associated with that best-matching key is then used to handle the query: in RAG, the document that is best suited to answer the question is typically prefixed to the query. candidates.summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. candidates.title: An AI Spore agent built a Godot game, then tested and revised it with bots
candidates.summary:
I’m building Spore, an Apache-2.0 runtime for persistent AI agents. Here’s an experiment using it to build and test a small Godot game.

The agent wrote the game, generated its art and sound in code, and wrote bots to test its balance over seeded runs. It passed the first prompt’s targets—but reviewing the results exposed gaps those targets didn’t cover.

A second prompt added requirements. The agent improved its search, revised the bargain mechanic and fixed the ending. Nobody edited the game by hand.

candidates.title: Neuro: a language that compiles training code to a native binary
candidates.summary:
I’ve spent about a year building Neuro, a programming language for AI work. You write the model, the training loop and the GPU code in one language, and the compiler produces a single native program. Whoever runs it doesn’t need Python installed.

This small program trains on the CPU, then predicts on the GPU:
